clips.title: The story
paras: Camp Narache is a secluded village nestled upon Red Cloud Mesa in southern Mulgore. It serves as the ancestral home of the Hawkwind tribe and the proving ground where young tauren begin their training. Sheltered high above the plains, the camp maintains ancient traditions while constantly guarding against encroaching quilboar and lingering centaur threats.

Situated at the northern edge of the elevated Red Cloud Mesa, Camp Narache is the primary settlement of the Hawkwind tribe. The village consists of several large hide lodges and pavilions, including a communal tent for wounded braves, an armory, a bakery tent, and a spirit lounge dedicated to meditation and ancestral communion. At the center of the camp, tribal elders and path trainers stand in a circle at the heart of the camp, where the venerable Greatmother Hawkwind still offers guidance, guiding newly initiated youth as they step into their roles as defenders of the Earth Mother.

Though naturally fortified by the steep sheer cliffs of the mesa, Camp Narache faces persistent unrest. Bristleback quilboar from Brambleblade Ravine continuously encroach upon Hawkwind lands, while centaur scouts linger in the distance. Young hunters, shamans, druids, and warriors prove their mettle here by culling the aggressive local wildlife, protecting the village's water well, and turning back quilboar raiders before descending the grand path into the wider valleys of Mulgore.
